ranked.headline: Learned models infer gene regulation and cell states from single-cell and spatial omics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair gene regulatory inference from single-cell and spatial omics with explicit validation of predictions.

ranked.headline: Reproducible open-source tools now span epigenomic, cancer, and variant analysis
ranked.summary: Recent software papers and a preprint deliver reproducible pipelines and packages for methylation, chromatin, cancer genomics, and QTL analysis.

ranked.headline: Omics models tested for cross-population generalization and modality translation
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and methods probe whether omics foundation and generative models hold across ancestry groups, modalities, and class imbalance.

ranked.headline: Histology and spatial transcriptomics are being coupled through multimodal learning
ranked.summary: Foundation and graph models now link histology, spatial expression and niche annotation at larger cohort and atlas scales.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware tools outperform sequence baselines for viral taxonomic placement
ranked.summary: Structural and ML features are benchmarked against sequence-only baselines across RNA virus placement, alignment difficulty, and structure search.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks expose limits of AI structure predictors on fuzzy protein complexes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a bioinformatics benchmark test learned protein models on disordered, fuzzy and cryo-EM targets.

ranked.headline: Deep learning advances cryo-EM density, antibody structure, and equilibrium sampling
ranked.summary: Deep models now target cryo-EM density maps, MD-derived topology, antibody structure, and Boltzmann-style equilibrium sampling of ensembles.

ranked.headline: Learned models prioritize peptide and epitope candidates from predicted structure
ranked.summary: Structure-aware generative and scoring models for peptides and epitopes are appearing across preprints and peer-reviewed venues in June 2026.

ranked.headline: Generative models condition molecular and single-cell design on structural and expression…
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and published work extend diffusion, flow and adversarial generators to ligand design, biomolecular co-design and single-cell profile editing.

ranked.headline: Computational tools for multi-omics integration, spatial profiling, and network analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair scalable algorithms with packaged software for integrating single-cell, spatial, and multi-omic datasets.

ranked.headline: Error-aware demultiplexing of long-read sequencing barcodes and indels
ranked.summary: Nanopore barcoding artefacts and indel-rich errors are now addressed directly by new long-read demultiplexers and read-structure-agnostic tools.

ranked.headline: Tools detect splicing and polyadenylation events missing from reference annotation
ranked.summary: Routine short-read RNA-seq is being repurposed to detect unannotated splicing, polyadenylation, and fusion events.

ranked.headline: Models fusing heterogeneous evidence to infer gene function and regulatory interactions
ranked.summary: Ensemble, graph, and enrichment-statistics methods for function and interaction prediction appeared across June 1 to June 6, 2026.

ranked.headline: Informative perturbations and learned priors resolve parameter and structure ambiguity
ranked.summary: Mechanistic models of signaling and gene regulation remain underdetermined, motivating inference coupled to perturbation design and external priors.

ranked.headline: Automated pipelines take bacterial reads to strain genotypes and population analyses
ranked.summary: Modular long-read and metagenomic pipelines now span assembly, strain reconstruction and population genetics within single automated workflows.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools are automating discrete steps in genomic and molecular workflows
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications report reusable, programmatically accessible tools for defined steps in genomic, molecular and structural workflows.

ranked.headline: Predictive models closing the loop on generative and perturbation-based design
ranked.summary: Recent items encode binding behaviour, combination response, and pathway logic directly into design and screening loops.

ranked.headline: Protein language models are being applied to protein-protein interface prediction
ranked.summary: Protein language model representations now predict protein-protein interfaces, binding affinity, and host-pathogen interactions from sequence alone.

ranked.headline: Data composition and analytic choices distort potency, prediction and testing estimates
ranked.summary: Bias and analytic choices are now being detected and benchmarked explicitly, since they can inflate reported performance and reverse conclusions.

ranked.headline: Computational restoration of degraded electron microscopy data before structural analysis
ranked.summary: Recent work applies diffusion, sparse regularization, and prompt-based segmentation to noisy cryo-EM, cryo-ET, and serial-section data.

ranked.headline: Platforms link literature, ontologies and omics into queryable biomedical graphs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a journal platform pair curated knowledge resources with LLM and text-mining tools for biomedical evidence.

ranked.headline: Cell-type and splicing QTL maps nominate effector genes and disease-linked variants
ranked.summary: Recent studies test whether cell-type-resolved regulatory maps, anchored to GWAS loci and AD-linked splicing, improve variant-to-gene prioritization.

ranked.headline: Frozen and held-out evaluations expose generalization limits of biological foundation…
ranked.summary: Benchmarks with frozen, zero-shot, and held-out designs are testing whether pretrained biological models generalize beyond their training regimes.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models for ligand binding sites, co-folding, and sequence design
ranked.summary: Preprints now pair protein language models and co-folding with agentic tool use and pocket-level benchmarking for drug target and sequence design.

ranked.headline: Representation learning maps single-cell and imaging states onto structured geometries
ranked.summary: Structured representations of single-cell and microscopy data now resolve malignant states, organelle organization, and transcriptomic transitions.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models segment and analyze biomedical imaging structures across modalities
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one Bioinformatics paper apply domain-tailored learning architectures to lung, breast, organoid, spatial, and microscopy imaging data.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware search and similarity methods infer protein function and paralog…
ranked.summary: Structure-aware motif search and multi-tool paralog discovery now extend functional annotation beyond direct experimental evidence.

ranked.headline: Simulation Maps Disordered Domain States and Designed Peptide Binding Energetics
ranked.summary: Atomistic simulation now resolves pathways, metastable states and binding energetics for disordered regions and de novo designed peptides.

ranked.headline: Haplotype methods sharpen archaic introgression and selection inference
ranked.summary: Recent methods refine haplotype-based introgression and selection inference, improving S* thresholds, HMM decoding, and pooled-sequencing selection estimates.

ranked.headline: Duplication, transposition and chromosome rearrangement reshape eukaryotic genomes
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level assemblies across insects, plants, mollusks and mammals now allow mechanistic links between genomic architecture and lineage change.

ranked.headline: Formal tree-recovery guarantees for lineage and ancestral reconstruction
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs explicit probabilistic and combinatorial models with formal guarantees on recovering trees from lineage and ancestral data.

ranked.headline: Dynamical models couple phase separation, active processes, and swimmer morphology
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend dynamical formulations to outer membrane assembly, epithelial mechanics, swimmer design, and condensate thermodynamics.

ranked.headline: Compressed and decomposed representations of repetitive genomic sequence
ranked.summary: Prefix-free parsing and wavefront-based tandem repeat decomposition target repetitive genomic text at pangenome scale.

ranked.headline: Simulation-based inference recovers protein energetics and conformational ensembles
ranked.summary: Simulation outputs now serve as the substrate for inference across cross-linking, single-molecule tracking, and super-resolution microscopy.

ranked.headline: Bacterial genomes inform pathogen surveillance, AMR forecasting and strain nomenclature
ranked.summary: Large bacterial genome datasets, nanopore amplicon panels and stable strain codes now support real-time pathogen surveillance and forecasting.

ranked.headline: Multi-omics and foundation models resolve functional effects of tumor genome alterations
ranked.summary: Larger tumor cohorts and single-cell atlases now resolve functional impact of somatic variants at domain and regulatory resolution.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools automate segmentation and quantification of microscopy images
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers present end-to-end, user-facing workflows that package segmentation and quantification for microscopy data.

ranked.headline: Computational narrowing of large search spaces before targeted experimental confirmation
ranked.summary: Large spatial, single-cell, and protein-embedding datasets demand traceable computational prioritization ahead of targeted experimental confirmation.

ranked.headline: Long-read transcript models are being coupled directly to proteomic readouts
ranked.summary: Long-read RNA-seq isoform models now feed ORF prediction, peptide mapping, and database construction for proteomics.

ranked.headline: Chromatin loop strength tracks genetic variation, methylation, and CTCF occupancy
ranked.summary: Population-scale Hi-C and Y chromosome assemblies now expose sequence and structural variation shaping 3D genome architecture.
